1.text: Abacira umugani wo kubigisha ko bakwiriye gusenga iteka ntibarambirwe. Arababwira ati

2.text: “Hariho umucamanza mu mudugudu umwe, utubaha Imana ntiyite ku bantu.

3.text: Muri uwo mudugudu harimo umupfakazi, aramusanga aramubwira ati ‘Ndengera ku mwanzi wanjye.’

4.text: Amara iminsi atemera, ariko aho ageze aribwira ati ‘Nubwo ntubaha Imana kandi sinite ku bantu,

5.text: ariko kuko uyu mupfakazi anduhije ndamurengera, ngo adahora aza iminsi yose akandushya.’ ”

6.text: Nuko Umwami Yesu arabaza ati “Ntimwumvise ibyo umucamanza ukiranirwa yavuze?

7.text: Ubwo bibaye bityo, Imana se yo ntizarengera intore zayo ziyitakira ku manywa na nijoro? Mbese yazirangarana?

8.text: Ndababwira yuko izazirengera vuba. Ariko Umwana w'umuntu naza, mbese azasanga kwizera kukiri mu isi?”

9.text: Uyu mugani yawuciriye abiyiringiye ubwabo ko bakiranuka, bagahinyura abandi bose.

10.text: Ati “Abantu babiri bazamutse bajya mu rusengero gusenga, umwe yari Umufarisayo undi, ari umukoresha w'ikoro.

11.text: “Umufarisayo arahagarara, asengera mu mutima we ati ‘Mana, ndagushimiye yuko ntameze nk'abandi b'abanyazi n'abakiranirwa n'abasambanyi, cyangwa ndetse n'uyu mukoresha w'ikoro.

12.text: Mu minsi irindwi hose niyiriza ubusa kabiri, ntanga kimwe mu icumi mu byo nungutse byose.’

13.text: “Naho uwo mukoresha w'ikoro ahagarara kure, ntiyahangara no kūbura amaso ngo arebe mu ijuru, ahubwo yikubita mu gituza ati ‘Mana, mbabarira kuko ndi umunyabyaha.’

14.text: Ndababwira yuko uwo muntu yamanutse ajya iwe, ari we utsindishirijwe kuruta wa wundi, kuko uwishyira hejuru azacishwa bugufi, ariko uwicisha bugufi azashyirwa hejuru.”

15.text: Nuko bamuzanira abana bato ngo abakoreho, ariko abigishwa babibonye barabacyaha.

16.text: Maze Yesu arabahamagara ati “Mureke abana bato bansange, ntimubabuze kuko abameze batyo ubwami bw'Imana ari ubwabo.

17.text: Ndababwira ukuri yuko utemera ubwami bw'Imana nk'umwana muto, atazabwinjiramo na hato.”

18.text: Umutware aramubaza ati “Mwigisha mwiza, nkore nte ngo mbone kuragwa ubugingo buhoraho?”

19.text: Yesu na we aramusubiza ati “Unyitira iki mwiza? Nta mwiza keretse umwe, ni Imana.

20.text: Uzi amategeko ngo ‘Ntugasambane, ntukice, ntukibe, ntukabeshyere abandi, wubahe so na nyoko.’ ”

21.text: Aramubwira ati “Ayo yose narayitondeye mpereye mu buto bwanjye.”

22.text: Yesu abyumvise aramubwira ati “Noneho ushigaje kimwe: ibyo ufite byose ubigure uhe abakene, ni bwo uzagira ubutunzi mu ijuru, uhereko uze unkurikire.”

23.text: Abyumvise agira agahinda kenshi, kuko yari umutunzi cyane.

24.text: Yesu amwitegereje aramubwira ati “Erega biraruhije ko abatunzi binjira mu bwami bw'Imana!

25.text: Ndetse icyoroshye ni uko ingamiya yanyura mu zuru ry'urushinge, kuruta ko umutunzi yakwinjira mu bwami bw'Imana.”

26.text: Ababyumvise bati “Ubwo bimeze bityo ni nde ushobora gukizwa?”

28.text: Petero aramubwira ati “Dore twebwe twasize ibyacu turagukurikira.”

29.text: Arababwira ati “Ndababwira ukuri yuko ari nta muntu wasize inzu ye cyangwa umugore, cyangwa bene se cyangwa ababyeyi cyangwa abana ku bw'ubwami bw'Imana,

30.text: utazongerwa ibirutaho cyane muri iki gihe, no mu gihe kizaza agahabwa ubugingo buhoraho.”

31.text: Yesu yihererana n'abo cumi na babiri arababwira ati “Dore turazamuka tujye i Yerusalemu, kandi ibyanditswe n'abahanuzi byose bizasohora ku Mwana w'umuntu.

32.text: Azagambanirwa mu bapagani, azashinyagurirwa, bazamukoza isoni bamucire amacandwe,

33.text: kandi nibamara kumukubita imikoba bazamwica, maze ku munsi wa gatatu azazuka.”

34.text: Ariko ntibagira icyo bamenya muri ibyo, kuko ayo magambo bari bayahishwe, ntibamenya ibyo babwiwe.

35.text: Nuko yenda kugera i Yeriko, impumyi yari yicaye iruhande rw'inzira isabiriza,

36.text: yumvise abantu benshi bahita ibaza ibyo ari byo.

37.text: Barayibwira bati “Ni Yesu w'i Nazareti uhita.”

38.text: Irataka cyane iti “Yesu mwene Dawidi, mbabarira.”

39.text: Abagiye imbere barayicyaha ngo iceceke, ariko irushaho gutaka iti “Mwene Dawidi, mbabarira.”

40.text: Yesu arahagarara, ategeka ko bayimuzanira. Igeze bugufi arayibaza ati

42.text: Yesu arayibwira ati “Humuka, kwizera kwawe kuragukijije.”

43.text: Ako kanya arahumuka, amukurikira ahimbaza Imana. Abantu bose babibonye bashima Imana.
